periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped; the visual height of the patch is significantly greater than its horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward elongation, with the lowest point of the patch tapering well below the geometric center of the eye.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A clear gap is visible between the ear regions, approximately matching the width of the cranial vault between them.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears are perfectly rounded and semicircular with no flattening visible.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-beige coloration or staining across the ventral fur of the abdomen, contrasting with the off-white fur of the head.
